method: design/bal/FIXC-TRANSLATION.md; per-sample translation then group median (SAR-percentile groups 20-30 / 45-55 / 70-80 of 2,891 ok runs; 109 failed runs excluded exactly as splits.py)

gSC.source: G(V0) of the preset (calibration.ts START_STATE.fast.g 27.600) + group median of per-sample (AIFM progress at AC - progress at V0 date 2025.445) = 4.533 OOM; CAL2-T route (workTypes.ts:304-308) with SC read as AC

sdSC.source: AIFM ai_research_taste_at_coding_automation_anchor_sd, group median (taste at AC, same milestone as gSC)
sdSC.alt_note: above TOP_SD 3.09 in fast: SAR comes before AI2027-SC in about half of the runs

dBM.source: TOP_SD 3.09 / (ai_research_taste_slope / anchor_progress_rate) per sample, group median (CAL-world-sources.md section 3; workTypes.ts:300-303)

r.source: AIFM results.r_software (calibrated per run; SE = r*log10(RS), _impl.py:1079), group median

rc.source: AIFM rho_coding_labor, group median; the draw is the discrete set {-5 (25%), -2 (50%), -1 (25%)} so the median is the mode

Ca.source: AIFM inf_compute_asymptote, group median (not asked; the same production block)

slow10.source: AIFM inv_compute_anchor_exp_cap, group median (not asked; the same production block)

startState.note: Observed history, same for every group: AIFM present_day 2026.578 and present_horizon 186 are fixed in all samples; AIFM's own progress multiplier at 2025.5 is 1.06 in every group (fast 1.064, central 1.056, slow 1.068), inside the game's start-M check (1.01-1.25). START_STATE g differs by preset only through playerStart's closed form (27.60 / 27.63 / 27.77); it enters gSC through G(V0) only.

fitNeeded: horizon law (no per-group setting; AIFM's superexponential horizon cannot be followed by the fixed 4.2 per OOM)
takeoff gaps SC->SAR->SIAR->ASI (AIFM's excess uplift doubling time and experiment-compute bottleneck have no game setting)
